info.title: API.SH: CeX
info.description: The CeX API from API.SH: public CeX data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Products and categories matching what a shopper is typing: product id, name, link, category, department, price and image, plus matching categories with counts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cex-autocomplete

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: CeX departments, product lines and categories
get.description:
The CeX catalogue tree: without parameters every department and product line (with its number of categories); `department` keeps one department's product lines; `product_line` lists its categories with the number of products and whether CeX sells and buys them. Use the ids in /cex/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cex-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: CeX product details with buy, cash and exchange prices
get.description:
One CeX product (box) by id or product-detail link: name, category, department, the selling price (previous and first price, date of the last price change), the cash and exchange prices CeX pays for it, rating, online quantity, collection quantity, whether it can be bought or sold on the web, description (text and HTML), variant, every specification, images and `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cex-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A CeX box id (from search) or a product link like https://uk.webuy.com/product-detail?id=SAPPI13128GMUNLB.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: CeX store stock for a product
get.description:
Which CeX stores hold a product: every store with it in stock and every store it can be collected from, the online quantity, and with `lat`/`lng` the ten nearest stores with the quantity on hand, collection quantity, distance in miles and opening hours.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cex-product-stock

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A CeX box id or product link.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude for the nearest stores (with lng).

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude for the nearest stores (with lat).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of a product on the UK site with its rating summary (average, count, distribution): rating, title, text, date, reviewer nickname and location, recommended flag, helpful votes, badges and photos. Filter by stars, photos or words; sort by relevance, date, rating or helpfulness. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cex-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A CeX product id (box id) or product link.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars (1-5).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: CeX product search with filters, buy and sell prices
get.description:
Search CeX (webuy.com) in any of its country sites: phones, games, consoles, computing, electronics, film and music. Each product: box id, name, link, category, department, product lines, grade, the price CeX sells it for (with previous and first price), the cash and exchange prices CeX pays when you sell it, rating, online and in-store stock, number of stores holding it, availability, every attribute (capacity, network, colour, model...) and `raw`. The answer lists every filter group with values and counts (pass them back in `filters`) and the price range. `mode=sell` lists only items CeX currently buys. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cex-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keywords. Optional when category, department, product_line, store or filters is given.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category id (1227) or name (iPhone 13) from /cex/v1/categories or a result's `category`.

parameters.name: product_line
parameters.description: A product line id (113) or name (iPhones).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Attribute filters as `Name:value;Name:value1|value2`, names and values from the answer's `facets`, e.g. `Grade:B;Capacity:128GB|256GB`.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Only items in stock at this store (a store name from the answer's facets or /cex/v1/stores).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: buy: everything for sale; sell: only items CeX buys from you (cash/exchange prices).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
